notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only tower-specific source is one row in the tnlandforms Georgia list: name 'wright', coordinates, county Montgomery, elevation 283 (no unit given; read as feet this matches the 86.3 m in the record), and a last field 'datasheet CL2136'. Other rows in the list carry 'datasheet' followed by a code, but no source read explains what the code means, so the story quotes the field and does not call it a source. Nothing found gives a build date, staffing, fire history, fate or access. Name collisions to avoid: Wright Mountain (Fentress County, Tennessee, in the cached FOREST LOOKOUTS pages), Wright's Tower (Medford, Massachusetts, WPA 1937), and Wrightsboro (Columbia County, Georgia, a separate list entry, GA269). A search hit titled 'Fire Tower Rd' was a listing at an Atlanta address and was not used. Verification pass 2026-10-21: flagged the missing elevation unit; replaced 'names a datasheet ... as its source' with a quote of the last field; the Continental army wording is now 'brigadier general', as the source says; the statewide sentence no longer copies the Vanishing Georgia wording. The brief's county, coordinates and elevation match the list.
